sender.en: “GOV IE” or the “Department of Social Protection”

name.en: “GOV IE” text offering a reduced electricity bill or an emergency payment

how.en: A text from “GOV IE” says you qualify for a reduced electricity bill or a payment under an “Emergency Benefit Scheme”, with a link to claim. It is timed to look like real supports, such as payments after a storm or past energy credits. The link leads to a fake page that collects your personal and bank details. The Department of Social Protection has confirmed the text is a scam.

text.en: A text from “GOV IE” says you qualify for a benefit.
It offers a reduced electricity bill or an emergency payment.
It gives a link to claim.
GOV-IE: Your household has been approved for a €200 winter energy support credit. Claim before 31 Jan or the credit will be reassigned: [link]

en: gov ie text reduced electricity bill
text saying i qualify for an energy credit
department of social protection text with link
storm payment text asking for bank details
A benefit offered by text with a link.
A deadline to claim money you never applied for.
Don’t click. Check supports only on the government’s official websites or MyWelfare, typed in yourself.
If you entered bank or card details, call your bank.

sources.title: Warning of scam text message for reduced electricity bill
